Audit_item: Exact MCU package and pin count
Evidence_or_required_action: STM32F401CCU6 uses the UFQFPN48/UQFN48 pin table plus exposed ground pad
PB11 is not bonded out in UFQFPN48; SRC_A1 moved from PB11 to PA8
Every assigned MCU GPIO has one functional owner and alternate functions are mutually exclusive
PA0 is dedicated to ADC_BUFFERED and is never driven digitally
PA9 remains VBUS sense; PA10 is diode B drive because the Type-C design is device-only and USB ID is unused
PA13 PA14 NRST 3V3_D and GND reach the five-pin SWD header
PH0 and PH1 use the 8MHz HSE; PC14 and PC15 are buttons so no LSE crystal is fitted
Three VDD pins each have 100nF and the package has 10uF bulk
VDDA-VREF+ uses filtered 3V3_A with 1uF plus 100nF; VSSA-VREF- joins the continuous ground plane
The single VCAP_1 pin has one 4.7uF low-ESR capacitor and no other connection
VBAT ties to 3V3_D with 100nF because no backup battery is used
UFQFPN exposed pad is assigned to GND with a thermal-via array
External 10k pulldown selects normal flash boot and a service pad remains accessible
10k pullup 100nF capacitor reset button and SWD header connection are specified
TMUX1104 DGS pins 1 through 10 match the manufacturer pin table
TMUX1108 PW pins 1 through 16 match the manufacturer pin table; VSS and GND both connect to ground
Seven external 100k pulldowns hold both EN pins and all five address pins low during MCU reset
3.3V STM32 outputs exceed the mux 1.8V-compatible high threshold
Normal DUT nodes remain between GND and 3V3_A; out-of-range components are prohibited
U_SRC selects one path and U_SENSE selects one node; firmware transition state disables both before changing drives
Calibrated 330ohm guard separates the exposed R-C socket from the U_SRC common pin
All eight U_SENSE inputs receive 1kohm branch resistors and do not carry DUT excitation current
DBV pins are OUT=1 V-=2 +IN=3 -IN=4 V+=5 with OUT tied directly to -IN
OPA output uses 100ohm series isolation and PA0 has 1nF C0G to ground; Phase 5C settling is 147.10us to 1mV
Three equal 10k 0.1% resistors create ratiometric 1-3 and 2-3 rail taps; sense branches are high impedance
TPD4E1B06 DCK pins IO1=1 IO2=2 GND=3 IO3=4 IO4=5 NC=6 are used exactly
0.5nA maximum leakage and 0.95pF maximum capacitance were included in Phase 5C simulations
ESD arrays are not DC overvoltage disconnects; board must state unpowered and discharged components only
CC1 and CC2 each have independent 5.1k 1% Rd resistors to ground
Connector A6-B6 are tied as D+ and A7-B7 as D- before the flow-through ESD array
USBLC6-2SC6 is placed at the connector and each MCU line has 22ohm series resistance
PA9 senses USB_VBUS_FUSED through 1kohm and uses no internal pull
Shell stakes connect directly to the ground plane and ESD devices require short ground returns
TVS cathode connects to fused VBUS and B5819W anode-to-cathode direction feeds the LDO
Connector VBUS feeds PPTC first and the TVS is on the fused side so a sustained TVS short is source-limited
SOT25 pins VIN=1 GND=2 EN=3 NC=4 VOUT=5 are assigned exactly
Input and output each have 10uF plus 100nF X7R versus the 1uF minimum-compatible requirement
Continuous board target is capped at 150mA until regulator temperature and display current are measured
3V3_A derives from 3V3_D through a 45mohm-maximum DCR ferrite bead with local decoupling
One continuous ground plane is frozen; digital and ESD return placement prevents current through precision analog area
Modeled fault currents are at or below about 2.75mA and remain inside the STM32 ordinary GPIO drive capability
Two 1k legs bound current even when one GPIO is high and the other low
100ohm emitter 1Mohm base and 1k collector paths bound current; drive sequencing is defined
Board header order is explicitly frozen as GND 3V3 SCK MOSI CS DC RST BL and must be cabled to the actual module
Display interface and supply are 3.3V only; no 5V logic is routed to it
ABLS-8.000MHZ-B2-T with two 30pF C0G capacitors and fitted 0ohm tuning link is specified
Probe clock output rather than crystal pins and verify USB enumeration over voltage and temperature
Unused pins remain no-connect and firmware configures them analog no-pull; optional copper test pads have no external load
ESD2 IO3 and IO4 and both NC pins are explicitly left unconnected
All present results are simulation and design-review verified; fabricated-board ERC bring-up and calibration remain mandatory
